$\mathbb E[g(X)]=\sum_xg(x)p(x)$ (discrete) or $\int g(x)p(x)\,dx$ (density), defined when the same sum or integral of $|g|$ is finite ($g(X)$ is then integrable). Linearity: $\mathbb E[aX+bY+c]=a\,\mathbb E[X]+b\,\mathbb E[Y]+c$ for integrable random variables, dependent or not. The indicator $\mathbf 1_A$ of an event is $1$ if $A$ occurs and $0$ otherwise, so $\mathbb E[\mathbf 1_A]=\mathbb P(A)$: probabilities are expectations. The Heaviside step $H(v)=\mathbf 1\{v\gt0\}$ is the indicator of a positive argument (its value at $v=0$ is a convention), and $\mathbf 1\{f(z)\ge0\}$ is the safety indicator of a query $z$.
Subscripts name what is averaged: $\mathbb E_{x\sim\mu}[G(x)]$ averages $G$ over initial states drawn from $\mu$; $\mathbb E_{\tau\sim\pi}$ averages over trajectories generated jointly by the initial law, the policy $\pi$ and the transition law.

Worked example. For the excursion above, $\mathbb E[Z]=0\cdot\tfrac12+\int_0^1z\cdot\tfrac12\,dz=\tfrac14$: the atom contributes nothing, the density $\tfrac12$ on $(0,1]$ the rest. Counting violations: with $c_t=\mathbf 1\{x_t\gt1\}$ and $N=\sum_{t=1}^Tc_t$, linearity gives $\mathbb E[N]=\sum_t\mathbb P(x_t\gt1)$ even though the states of one episode are dependent. If each of $T=50$ steps violates with probability $0.004$, then $\mathbb E[N]=0.2$. Since $N$ is a nonnegative integer, $\mathbf 1\{N\ge1\}\le N$, hence $\mathbb P(\text{at least one violation})\le\mathbb E[N]=0.2$ whatever the dependence. A Boolean test becomes a signed monitor by subtracting one half: $\mathbf 1\{\text{test passed}\}-\tfrac12\in\{-\tfrac12,+\tfrac12\}$ is positive exactly when the test passes.

Definition — Variance, covariance, covariance matrix
Assume finite second moments for the variance and covariance formulas below. $\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)^2]=\mathbb E[X^2]-(\mathbb EX)^2$; the standard deviation $\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}X}$ has the units of $X$ (noise variance $0.01$ means standard deviation $0.1$), and $\operatorname{Var}(aX+b)=a^2\operatorname{Var}X$. $\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)(Y-\mathbb EY)]$. For a random vector $X\in\mathbb R^n$ with mean $m$,
$$\Sigma=\operatorname{Cov}(X)=\mathbb E\big[(X-m)(X-m)^\top\big],\qquad \Sigma_{ij}=\operatorname{Cov}(X_i,X_j),\qquad \operatorname{Cov}(AX+b)=A\Sigma A^\top .$$
Isotropic noise has $\Sigma=\sigma^2I$: uncorrelated coordinates with the same variance $\sigma^2$ in every direction. The correlation of $X,Y$ with standard deviations $\sigma_X,\sigma_Y\gt0$ is $\rho=\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)/(\sigma_X\sigma_Y)$, the covariance of the standardised variables. It lies in $[-1,1]$ because $0\le\operatorname{Var}\big(\tfrac X{\sigma_X}\pm\tfrac Y{\sigma_Y}\big)=2(1\pm\rho)$, and $\rho=\pm1$ exactly when $Y$ is almost surely an affine function of $X$ (slope of sign $\pm$). In these terms the vector $(X,Y)$ has covariance matrix $\begin{bmatrix}\sigma_X^2&\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y\\\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y&\sigma_Y^2\end{bmatrix}$.

$$\mathbb P(s_0,a_0,s_1,a_1,s_2)=\mu(s_0)\,\pi(a_0\mid s_0)\,P(s_1\mid s_0,a_0)\,\pi(a_1\mid s_1)\,P(s_2\mid s_1,a_1),$$

and total probability gives marginals, $\mathbb P(s_1=s')=\sum_{s,a}\mu(s)\,\pi(a\mid s)\,P(s'\mid s,a)$. For instance, from $\mu=\delta_{s_0}$ with two actions of probability $0.5$ each that reach an unsafe state with probabilities $0.2$ and $0.6$, $\mathbb P(s_1\text{ unsafe})=0.5\cdot0.2+0.5\cdot0.6=0.4$. Decorations such as $\mathbb P^\pi_\mu$ or $\mathbb E_{\tau\sim\pi}$ record which $\mu$, $\pi$ and $P$ generate the trajectory; change any of them and every probability changes.

Definition — Conditional expectation and the tower rule
$\mathbb E[X\mid Y=y]=\sum_xx\,p(x\mid y)$ (or $\int x\,p(x\mid y)\,dx$) is a number for each $y$; inserting the random $Y$ gives the random variable $\mathbb E[X\mid Y]$, the predictor of $X$ from $Y$ that minimises mean squared error when $\mathbb E[X^2]\lt\infty$. For an event with $\mathbb P(A)\gt0$, $\mathbb E[X\mid A]=\mathbb E[X\mathbf 1_A]/\mathbb P(A)$, i.e. $\mathbb E[X\mathbf 1_A]=\mathbb P(A)\,\mathbb E[X\mid A]$. Two rules do most of the work:
$$\underbrace{\mathbb E\big[\mathbb E[X\mid Y]\big]=\mathbb E[X]}_{\text{tower rule}},\qquad \underbrace{\mathbb E[g(Y)\,X\mid Y]=g(Y)\,\mathbb E[X\mid Y]}_{\text{take out what is known}} .$$
Proof of the tower rule (discrete): $\sum_yp(y)\sum_xx\,p(x\mid y)=\sum_{x,y}x\,p(x,y)=\mathbb E[X]$. $\square$

Worked example (averaging over a policy). In a state $s$, action $a_1$ has expected cost $\mathbb E[X\mid a_1]=2$ and action $a_2$ has $\mathbb E[X\mid a_2]=10$. Under $\pi=(0.7,0.3)$ the tower rule gives $\mathbb E[X]=0.7\cdot2+0.3\cdot10=4.4$. Under another policy $\pi'=(0.9,0.1)$ the conditional expectations, a property of the environment, are unchanged and only the weights move: $0.9\cdot2+0.1\cdot10=2.8$. The performance-difference lemma averages the advantage of $\pi$ over the actions of $\pi'$ in exactly this way.

Theorem — Law of total variance
$\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb E\big[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)\big]+\operatorname{Var}\big(\mathbb E[X\mid Y]\big)$: the average spread within groups plus the spread of the group means. Proof. With $\bar X=\mathbb E[X\mid Y]$, the tower rule gives $\mathbb E[X^2]=\mathbb E\big[\mathbb E[X^2\mid Y]\big]=\mathbb E\big[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)+\bar X^2\big]$ and $\mathbb E[X]=\mathbb E[\bar X]$; subtract $(\mathbb E\bar X)^2$ from both sides. $\square$ For vectors, $\operatorname{Cov}(X)=\mathbb E[\operatorname{Cov}(X\mid Y)]+\operatorname{Cov}(\mathbb E[X\mid Y])$.
Definition — Mixture distribution
First draw a label $L$ with $\mathbb P(L=j)=w_j$, then draw $X$ from the component law $p_j$ (mean $m_j$, variance $\sigma_j^2$). Then $X$ has density $p(x)=\sum_jw_jp_j(x)$, mean $\bar m=\sum_jw_jm_j$ and, by total variance, $\operatorname{Var}X=\sum_jw_j\sigma_j^2+\sum_jw_j(m_j-\bar m)^2$.

Worked example (small and large errors). Residuals that are $\mathcal N(0,0.5^2)$ with probability $0.8$ and $\mathcal N(0,3^2)$ with probability $0.2$ (the "80% small, 20% large" option of the Module 15 explorer) have variance $0.8\cdot0.25+0.2\cdot9=2$. Their tail is nothing like that of $\mathcal N(0,2)$: $\mathbb P(|E|\gt5)=0.8\cdot\mathbb P(|Z|\gt10)+0.2\cdot\mathbb P(|Z|\gt\tfrac53)\approx0.019$, against $0.0004$ for the Gaussian with the same variance, while near zero the mixture is more concentrated ($\mathbb P(|E|\gt1)\approx0.18$ against $0.48$). An ensemble of $E$ Gaussian predictions is an equal-weight mixture: its covariance is the average member covariance (aleatoric part) plus the covariance of the member means (epistemic part, the $\hat\Sigma$ of Section 1).

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedFiniteMixtureMaterial24
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def finiteMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i

theorem actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast hw

theorem actual_finite_mixture_integral
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Integrable X (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  rw [finiteMixture, integral_finsetSum_measure
    (fun i _ => (hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top)]
  simp [NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]

theorem actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) : MemLp X 2 (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable X (finiteMixture w μ) := by
    rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
    exact AEStronglyMeasurable.sum_measure
      (fun i => ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).aestronglyMeasurable)
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hs).mpr
  rw [finiteMixture, integrable_finsetSum_measure]
  intro i _
  exact ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).integrable_sq

theorem actual_finite_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i :=
  actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ X (fun i => (hX i).integrable one_le_two)

theorem actual_finite_mixture_variance
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    variance X (finiteMixture w μ) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑ j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  have hr : ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hw
  let m : ι → ℝ := fun i => ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i
  let M : ℝ := ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * m i
  have he : (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - M^2 := by
    have hexp (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2 =
        (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2 - (2*M)*((w i : ℝ)*m i) +
          M^2 * (w i : ℝ) := by ring
    simp_rw [hexp]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hr]
    change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - (2*M)*M + M^2*1 = _
    ring
  rw [variance_eq_sub (actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment w μ X hX),
    actual_finite_mixture_mean w μ X hX]
  have hsq := actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ (fun ω => (X ω)^2)
    (fun i => (hX i).integrable_sq)
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply] at hsq ⊢
  rw [hsq]
  have hv (i : ι) : variance X (μ i) = (∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - (m i)^2 :=
    variance_eq_sub (hX i)
  simp_rw [hv, mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - M^2 =
      ((∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) -
        ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) + ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2
  rw [he]
  ring

theorem actual_finite_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    finiteMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =
      base.withDensity ((w i : ℝ≥0∞) • p i) :=
    (withDensity_smul (w i : ℝ≥0∞) (hp i)).symm
  simp_rw [he]
  change (Measure.sum (fun i => base.withDensity (fun ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω))) = _
  rw [← withDensity_tsum (μ := base)
    (f := fun i ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω)
    (fun i => measurable_const.mul (hp i))]
  congr 1
  ext ω
  simp [tsum_fintype, smul_eq_mul]

variable [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]

def twoStageLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure (ι × Ω) :=
  finiteMixture w (fun i => (Measure.dirac i).prod (μ i))

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_joint_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (twoStageLaw w μ) :=
  actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw _

theorem actual_two_stage_label_and_component_rectangle
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) (s : Set Ω) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    twoStageLaw w μ ({j} ×ˢ s) = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) * μ j s := by
  classical
  simp only [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Measure.prod_prod, Measure.dirac_apply, Set.indicator_singleton, Pi.one_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hb, Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_second_marginal_is_the_finite_mixture
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    (twoStageLaw w μ).snd = finiteMixture w μ := by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.snd_apply hs]
  have hpre : Prod.snd ⁻¹' s = (Set.univ : Set ι) ×ˢ s := by
    ext p
    simp
  rw [hpre]
  simp [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.prod_prod]

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedFiniteMixtureMaterial24

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedCountableMixtureMaterial24
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Countable ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def countableMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  Measure.sum (fun i => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (countableMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [countableMixture, Measure.sum_apply_of_countable, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact hw

theorem actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : Integrable X (countableMixture w μ)) :
    HasSum (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i)
      (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) := by
  simpa only [countableMixture, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.coe_toReal,
    smul_eq_mul] using hasSum_integral_measure hX

theorem actual_countable_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) =
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  exact (actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ X
    (hX.integrable one_le_two)).tsum_eq.symm

private theorem component_centered_second_moment
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (M : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ) = variance X μ + ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) - M)^2 := by
  have hx := hX.integrable one_le_two
  have hp : (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2) =
      (fun ω => (X ω)^2 - (2*M)*X ω + M^2) := by ext ω; ring
  rw [hp]
  change (∫ ω, ((fun ω => (X ω)^2) - (fun ω => (2*M)*X ω)) ω + M^2 ∂μ) = _
  rw [integral_add (hX.integrable_sq.sub (hx.const_mul (2*M)))
    (integrable_const _)]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [integral_sub hX.integrable_sq (hx.const_mul (2*M)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const, variance_eq_sub hX]
  simp only [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul, Pi.pow_apply]
  ring

theorem actual_countable_mixture_variance_and_series_summability
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ))
    (hXi : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) ∧
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) *
      ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2) ∧
    variance X (countableMixture w μ) =
      (∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  let M : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ
  let a : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)
  let b : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - M)^2
  have hs := actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2)
    (hX.sub (memLp_const M)).integrable_sq
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ i) = a i + b i := by
    rw [component_centered_second_moment (μ i) X (hXi i) M]
    simp only [a, b, mul_add]
  simp_rw [he] at hs
  have ha0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ a i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (variance_nonneg _ _)
  have hb0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ b i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have has : Summable a := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ha0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_right (hb0 i)) hs.summable
  have hbs : Summable b := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hb0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_left (ha0 i)) hs.summable
  have hm := actual_countable_mixture_mean w hw μ X hX
  have hvar : variance X (countableMixture w μ) = (∑' i, a i) + ∑' i, b i := by
    rw [variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable, ← hs.tsum_eq]
    exact has.tsum_add hbs
  simpa only [a, b, M, hm] using And.intro has (And.intro hbs hvar)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    countableMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =
      base.withDensity ((w i : ℝ≥0∞) • p i) :=
    (withDensity_smul (w i : ℝ≥0∞) (hp i)).symm
  simp_rw [countableMixture, he]
  change (Measure.sum (fun i => base.withDensity (fun ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω))) = _
  rw [← withDensity_tsum (μ := base)
    (f := fun i ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω)
    (fun i => measurable_const.mul (hp i))]
  congr 1
  ext ω
  exact ENNReal.tsum_apply

variable [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]

def twoStageLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure (ι × Ω) :=
  countableMixture w (fun i => (Measure.dirac i).prod (μ i))

theorem actual_two_stage_joint_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (twoStageLaw w μ) :=
  actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw _

theorem actual_two_stage_label_and_component_rectangle
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) (s : Set Ω) :
    twoStageLaw w μ ({j} ×ˢ s) = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) * μ j s := by

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedFiniteMixtureMaterial24
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def finiteMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i

theorem actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast hw

theorem actual_finite_mixture_integral
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Integrable X (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  rw [finiteMixture, integral_finsetSum_measure
    (fun i _ => (hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top)]
  simp [NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]

theorem actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) : MemLp X 2 (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable X (finiteMixture w μ) := by
    rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
    exact AEStronglyMeasurable.sum_measure
      (fun i => ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).aestronglyMeasurable)
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hs).mpr
  rw [finiteMixture, integrable_finsetSum_measure]
  intro i _
  exact ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).integrable_sq

theorem actual_finite_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i :=
  actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ X (fun i => (hX i).integrable one_le_two)

theorem actual_finite_mixture_variance
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    variance X (finiteMixture w μ) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑ j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  have hr : ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hw
  let m : ι → ℝ := fun i => ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i
  let M : ℝ := ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * m i
  have he : (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - M^2 := by
    have hexp (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2 =
        (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2 - (2*M)*((w i : ℝ)*m i) +
          M^2 * (w i : ℝ) := by ring
    simp_rw [hexp]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hr]
    change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - (2*M)*M + M^2*1 = _
    ring
  rw [variance_eq_sub (actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment w μ X hX),
    actual_finite_mixture_mean w μ X hX]
  have hsq := actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ (fun ω => (X ω)^2)
    (fun i => (hX i).integrable_sq)
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply] at hsq ⊢
  rw [hsq]
  have hv (i : ι) : variance X (μ i) = (∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - (m i)^2 :=
    variance_eq_sub (hX i)
  simp_rw [hv, mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - M^2 =
      ((∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) -
        ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) + ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2
  rw [he]
  ring

theorem actual_finite_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    finiteMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =
      base.withDensity ((w i : ℝ≥0∞) • p i) :=
    (withDensity_smul (w i : ℝ≥0∞) (hp i)).symm
  simp_rw [he]
  change (Measure.sum (fun i => base.withDensity (fun ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω))) = _
  rw [← withDensity_tsum (μ := base)
    (f := fun i ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω)
    (fun i => measurable_const.mul (hp i))]
  congr 1
  ext ω
  simp [tsum_fintype, smul_eq_mul]

variable [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]

def twoStageLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure (ι × Ω) :=
  finiteMixture w (fun i => (Measure.dirac i).prod (μ i))

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_joint_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (twoStageLaw w μ) :=
  actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw _

theorem actual_two_stage_label_and_component_rectangle
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) (s : Set Ω) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    twoStageLaw w μ ({j} ×ˢ s) = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) * μ j s := by
  classical
  simp only [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Measure.prod_prod, Measure.dirac_apply, Set.indicator_singleton, Pi.one_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hb, Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_second_marginal_is_the_finite_mixture
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    (twoStageLaw w μ).snd = finiteMixture w μ := by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.snd_apply hs]
  have hpre : Prod.snd ⁻¹' s = (Set.univ : Set ι) ×ˢ s := by
    ext p
    simp
  rw [hpre]
  simp [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.prod_prod]

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Countable ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def countableMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  Measure.sum (fun i => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (countableMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [countableMixture, Measure.sum_apply_of_countable, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact hw

theorem actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : Integrable X (countableMixture w μ)) :
    HasSum (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i)
      (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) := by
  simpa only [countableMixture, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.coe_toReal,
    smul_eq_mul] using hasSum_integral_measure hX

theorem actual_countable_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) =
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  exact (actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ X
    (hX.integrable one_le_two)).tsum_eq.symm

private theorem component_centered_second_moment
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (M : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ) = variance X μ + ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) - M)^2 := by
  have hx := hX.integrable one_le_two
  have hp : (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2) =
      (fun ω => (X ω)^2 - (2*M)*X ω + M^2) := by ext ω; ring
  rw [hp]
  change (∫ ω, ((fun ω => (X ω)^2) - (fun ω => (2*M)*X ω)) ω + M^2 ∂μ) = _
  rw [integral_add (hX.integrable_sq.sub (hx.const_mul (2*M)))
    (integrable_const _)]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [integral_sub hX.integrable_sq (hx.const_mul (2*M)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const, variance_eq_sub hX]
  simp only [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul, Pi.pow_apply]
  ring

theorem actual_countable_mixture_variance_and_series_summability
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ))
    (hXi : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) ∧
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) *
      ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2) ∧
    variance X (countableMixture w μ) =
      (∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  let M : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ
  let a : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)
  let b : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - M)^2
  have hs := actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2)
    (hX.sub (memLp_const M)).integrable_sq
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ i) = a i + b i := by
    rw [component_centered_second_moment (μ i) X (hXi i) M]
    simp only [a, b, mul_add]
  simp_rw [he] at hs
  have ha0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ a i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (variance_nonneg _ _)
  have hb0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ b i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have has : Summable a := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ha0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_right (hb0 i)) hs.summable
  have hbs : Summable b := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hb0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_left (ha0 i)) hs.summable
  have hm := actual_countable_mixture_mean w hw μ X hX
  have hvar : variance X (countableMixture w μ) = (∑' i, a i) + ∑' i, b i := by
    rw [variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable, ← hs.tsum_eq]
    exact has.tsum_add hbs
  simpa only [a, b, M, hm] using And.intro has (And.intro hbs hvar)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    countableMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =

    (withDensity_smul (w i : ℝ≥0∞) (hp i)).symm
